POWERING ENTERPRISES & CORPORATES

Empower your business with a one-stop solution to manage and monitor every facet of corporate travel.

Unify employee spot rentals, monthly transport rosters, and multi-vendor invoices under a centralized, tamper-proof policy engine.

A control center for everything.

A centralised dashboard for all your corporate car rental vendors, spot bookings, and employee transport shifts in an easy-to-use interface.

  • Multi-vendor booking management with automated allocation
  • Custom corporate approval workflows, cost centers & project billing tags
  • Real-time proforma annexure magic-link approvals for procurement teams
  • Automated vendor SLA tier tracking with punctuality and vehicle compliance scoring

All the answers. With 100% route & billing clarity.

Get accurate, tamper-proof information about kilometers, routes taken, and invoice calculations with a single click.

  • 3-Way Distance Fraud Auditor (Odometer vs GPS vs OpenStreetMap Road distance)
  • Theoretical vs Practical fare reconciliation eliminating unverified extras
  • OTP-authenticated digital duty slips signed directly on passenger phones
  • Uploaded physical paper trip-sheet photo proof with high-res inspection loupe

Safer, easier travel for every employee.

Keep teams moving safely with automated compliance locks, smart route sequencing, and real-time passenger tracking.

  • Mandatory Women's Night-Shift Guard Lock (20:00–06:00 POSH compliance)
  • OSRM multi-stop pickup and drop route sequencer minimizing total in-cab duration
  • Live AIS-140 GPS tracking with instant SOS incident escalation matrix
  • Corporate EV Green-Corridor priority matching for ESG fleet targets

Helps your finance team plan better.

Make the most of predictive spend analytics and enterprise-grade security to control your organization's travel budgets.

  • 30-Day Corporate Expenditure Forecast and automated budget breach alerts
  • Scope-3 ESG carbon emission tracking and downloadable auditor certificates
  • Granular role-based access permissions for travel desks, managers and CFOs
  • Full 8-year immutable audit trail compliant with statutory corporate governance
POWERING CAR RENTAL COMPANIES

Better business with better technology.

An end-to-end operations management platform to manage your bookings, drivers, sub-vendors, pricing, and accounting from a single dashboard.

Instant booking intake & dispatch.

Convert unstructured client WhatsApp messages and emails into priced, geocoded duties in seconds.

  • Smart WhatsApp and email AI parser extracting pickup, drop and car category
  • Automated vehicle Insurance, Fitness, PUC and driver commercial license checks
  • 12-hour driver fatigue safety locks preventing exhausted chauffeur dispatches
  • 1-click completed trips bulk CSV/Excel upload with sample template download

Everything you need. In one place.

Complete oversight on theoretical estimates, practical odometer readings, driver expenses, and trip corrections.

  • Theoretical vs Practical pricing engine comparing estimates to ground reality
  • Inline odometer, toll, parking and final price correction workbench
  • Sequential vehicle odometer continuity checks flagging rollback and dead mileage
  • Split-view physical trip-sheet photo loupe for zero-dispute invoice generation

Dual-ledger accounting & reports made easy.

Separate corporate receivables from sub-vendor payables with automatic GST compliance and Tally integration.

  • Immutable Dual-Ledger P&L reconciliation locking client and vendor margins
  • Auto-Slab package optimizer (4Hr/40Km to 8Hr/80Km) with Margin-Floor Guardrail
  • Instant GST e-invoicing with SAC 996601 codes and IRN QR generation
  • 1-click Tally Prime XML export and post-invoice Credit/Debit note adjustments

Get paid faster. Control every payout.

Track corporate receivables, automate payment reminders, and control supplier fund releases with precision.

  • Automated 3-stage SaaS and corporate dunning reminders for outstanding balances
  • Axiom Treasury Fund Release Hold Toggle allowing 1-click vendor payout control
  • 30-Day Vendor Earnings & EMI coverage forecast maintaining fleet owner loyalty
  • Automated payment reconciliation matching bank UTR statements to duty invoices

Build your own brand & grow sales.

Elevate your company's perception with white-labeled duty slips and a built-in mobility CRM.

  • Native Prospect-to-Tenant Sales CRM pipeline tracking inquiries to signed contracts
  • Custom company branding on passenger WhatsApp dispatches and digital duty slips
  • 1-click master data migration from legacy TMS platforms, legacy spreadsheets and custom ERPs
  • Branded passenger feedback ratings and chauffeur performance leaderboards

Zero distance fraud. Guaranteed margins.

Stop revenue leakage caused by inflated sub-vendor kilometers or unbilled extra hours.

  • Automated 3-Way Distance Variance Hold (>10% odometer delta locked before payout)
  • Maker-Checker billing verification queue for multi-tier accounting sign-offs
  • Complete vendor SLA performance scoring penalizing delayed or non-reporting cabs
  • Real-time tariff engine catching unbilled toll, state tax and night allowance charges
MOBILE OPERATIONS

The Axiom Driver App & Vendor Pocket Dispatcher.

Replace paper duty slips on the road, and let fleet owners assign cabs right from their phone at home—no laptop required.

OTP-Based Duty Validation

Chauffeurs start and end trips with secure passenger OTPs, completely eliminating unauthorized duties.

Camera Odometer & Toll Receipt Capture

Mandatory camera snap of physical vehicle dashboard and toll receipts stored directly on the duty slip.

Turn-by-Turn Navigation & Offline Breadcrumbs

Built-in route navigation that stores breadcrumbs locally during cellular drops and syncs once back online.

Paper Trip-Sheet Photo Upload Fallback

If corporate clients require physical paper signatures, drivers upload a clean picture for 1-click billing.

Built For Fleet Owners on the Move

Manage fleet operations from home or while travelling without needing to carry a heavy laptop.

Live Operational Pulse

Track unassigned duties, running vehicles, completed jobs, and today's gross billed revenue in real-time.

2-Tap Cab & Chauffeur Assignment

Select unassigned corporate duties and assign available vehicle and driver with two thumb taps.

Instant WhatsApp Chauffeur Broadcast

Automatically triggers vehicle number, chauffeur contact and reporting time to passenger via WhatsApp.
